metadata.description: The AI layer for running the business, with Odoo as the system of record: the pipeline end to end for every role — capture a lead against a real customer, close it won or lost, raise the quotation and see what is still owed — plus a live governance demo and the admin control plane.

plugins.name: systemprompt-business
plugins.description: What every signed-in user gets: read what's happening on Odoo — a business-wide brief or your own day — create and update leads against real customers, walk them to a decision, close them won or lost and raise the quotation that follows, and sweep everything outstanding one item at a time, all as you. Seven live dashboards back the four skills: the business overview, inbound leads, open pipeline, upcoming deals, recent team notes, a to-do bulletin, and outstanding invoices.

plugins.name: systemprompt-demo
plugins.description: Trip the governance pipeline on purpose and watch it answer: a call held for a second human, a secret refused before it costs anything, a destructive tool blocked by name — then read back the audited decision trail for exactly what happened. Every beat is a real tool call; every outcome is an audit row.

plugins.name: systemprompt-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only: the control plane underneath the business — operate the stack, prove governance live, and read back what every task cost — plus first-run setup, the only skill that installs dashboards. Ships the systemprompt CLI and knowledge-bank servers and five live dashboards, including the brain@ inbox feed and the approval queue that is the only route from an email into Odoo.
